## Decision models: train long texts and 9B models as a whole
- **Whole-model training of Clef 9B and Kev 9B now finishes.** Since 0.2.112, `astronomical decision train --whole-model` on a 9B decision model trained and then failed at the very end with "the worker is unavailable", because the trained weights were too large to hand back. They now pass from the engine to the command line through a private temporary file, which is deleted once read. - **Long texts no longer run out of memory.** A text too long to train on all at once is now trained layer by layer: each layer is computed again when it is needed instead of being kept. The trained model is exactly the same, it takes a fraction of the memory, and it is slower; the report says when this happened. On Clef 9B, one long text with ten questions now trains in about five minutes on a 48 GB Mac.
Your existing configuration and trained models keep working as before.
This release is signed with Astronomical's Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed update feed.
